title: Kingfisher hair day after a 60% meal

scenes.top_text: Me fixing my hair after eating 60% of my body weight in one day
Me guarding my snack spot from literally every other kingfisher

scenes.headline: Common kingfishers eat about 60% of their body weight a day
scenes.body: That's why they defend their stretch of river so hard. Rivals get displays, and sometimes a fight over the water.

caption:
That blue is high-maintenance.

When a common kingfisher dives, a membrane covers its eyes and it relies on touch to snap its bill shut. Then it whacks the fish against its perch to stun it before swallowing.

Source: Animal Diversity Web (Alcedo atthis).  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Two-panel 'me when' meme on our CC clips of common kingfishers (preening, then perched); the 60% figure pays off both jokes. Different species and layout mix from meme-1/3.
